I'm glad you were the one who came. I have an urgent and extremely important task for you. It concerns everyone still living in Tarkov. You know where the chemical plant is, don't you? I have strong reason to believe that something hazardous from that facility is seeping into the groundwater. This is a critical issue for us, especially since humanitarian aid deliveries are constantly being disrupted. We all rely on that water. Do you understand? Even filtration is no longer enough. If this isn't addressed soon, it could cost all of us our lives. To determine exactly what's happening, I need readings from a gas analyzer. You can find one at the plant. Leave the device in the laboratory there, and my people will retrieve it afterward.}} ==Requirements== * Must reach Loyalty Level 2 with [[Therapist]] to obtain this quest. ==Objectives== * Find 2 [[Gas analyzer]]s [[Found in raid|in raid]] * Hand over the 2 [[Gas analyzer]]s to [[Therapist]] ** (''Optional'') Locate the room with the [[Gas analyzer]]s on [[Factory]] * Stash a [[Gas analyzer]] in the med lab on [[Factory|Daytime Factory]] ==Rewards== * +10,000 [[EXP]] * [[Therapist]] Rep '''+0.25''' * 165,000 Roubles ** 173,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 189,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 {{quote|About time.
